title: Knowledge Portal presentations at ENDO 2021
summary: The Knowledge Portal team will present a talk and poster at ENDO 2021.
bodyHtml:
If you're attending ENDO 2021, the annual meeting of the Endocrine Society, be sure to check out these presentations from the Knowledge Portal team:

  • Jason Flannick will present a talk on the Type 2 Diabetes Knowledge Portal in session E11, "Scientific Literacy: Using the Result of Public Genomics Databases to Impact Endocrine Health." Video of the talk is available on demand for conference registrants.
  • Maria Costanzo and the Knowledge Portal team will present a poster with accompanying short video.
